profile.headline: Lead Software Developer
profile.summary:
Front End Web UI/UX Developer

Technical Skills:

- Front end Technologies: JavaScript, PHP, JQuery, JSON, W2UI,Bootstrap, Kendo UI, HTML/5, CSS/3, Ajax
- Software Design: OOAD, Design Patterns, Data Structure and Algorithm
- Databases: Oracle; My SQL, MS Access, eXist-db
- IDE/Tools: Eclipse; Net Beans; Visual Basic; Dreamweaver CS4, MS Visio; Astash UML tool; Photoshop, Gantt project
- Data Structures & Design Patterns

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain modern e-commerce frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and micro-frontend architecture. Build reusable UI components and integrate frontend applications with REST and GraphQL APIs and backend-for-frontend services. Work across MFE boundaries to troubleshoot authentication, session, cookie, cart, checkout, and customer-experience issues. Improve frontend quality through code reviews, testing, debugging, performance analysis, and CI/CD practices. Collaborate with product, UX, QA, backend, and platform teams to deliver production-ready features. Investigate complex production issues spanning browser behavior, frontend state, APIs, and Hybris-based commerce services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•       Developed and maintained enterprise web applications using Angular, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
•       Built responsive user interfaces and reusable frontend components to support business workflows.
•       Integrated frontend applications with REST APIs and collaborated with backend engineers to resolve integration issues.
•       Investigated defects, participated in code reviews, and supported testing and release activities.
•       Worked within Agile development processes to deliver enhancements and maintain application quality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Worked on on internal tools, “DevOps”. It is a deployment automation tool that upholds Development to Production (D2P) guidelines. Adherence to D2P provides all stakeholders the uniformity of a single platform for collaboration.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on End client (Ericson) civil side to build and modify Web-based application using traditional and object-oriented methodology. This tool is used by Ericsson’s telecom customer.  
• Define technical requirements based upon business requirements for EAMS. Tool unification for CAM, EF&I, QA, LMS, NIRT. 
• Using scrum methodology.

positions.title: Technical Assistant
positions.description: Supported network/device troubleshooting and documented technical solutions for students and university staff.

positions.title: Technical student Assistant
positions.description: Assist in troubleshooting remote access to the university network and device connectivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Used SOAP Perl Script for automation of SSD CM Build Branch request.
• Perform web site development of designing SSD CM junos Branch Request Form.
• Testing, maintenance and optimization, content updates, designed and implemented UI based on user and business requirements, information architecture.
• Analyzed and evaluated front-end design/usability challenges and implemented effective solutions. 
• Designs interactive navigation, controls and application flow.
• Environment: Perl, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: SJSU Research Foundation San Jose, CA
positions.description:
• Developed a complex web portal for Indian Dias Pora Project.
• Environment: PHP, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, SQL.

projects.title: Tender Management System
projects.description:
Built a website in group of 3 engineer. Website maintains history of listed tenders and provides information related to up-coming tender.
 	Developed a web site using HTML, CSS, and Java Script with MVC framework.
 	To control the future implementation we use version control system.
 	Designed queries, tables, views, constraints, in WAMP5 server.

projects.title: Counter Burger using Scrum
projects.description:
SCRUM life cycle software development.
Develop a web page using JAVA, JSP. using Eclipse API and SQL Server for database. We used HTML5 and CSS3 to design User Interface and created UML diagrams using Astah UML tool
